title: Nested shell blocks in Asks lose command actions
detail: At 97d960ac, a shell-language Markdown fence nested in a list item or blockquote lacks Open in terminal and its machine/folder label, and t skips it. The depth-zero condition in native/crates/attn-app/src/asks/commands.rs:34 excludes these fences. Plot s-0bje74 D2 applies to every shell-language block. Preserve the Markdown context and document order when rendering and recognizing commands. Two reviewers confirmed the code trace. Existing live evidence covers top-level fences.
